newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends weak, Brent labours off lows.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends weak, Brent labours off lows.

text.p: IPE gas oil ended at session lows on Friday, depressed by weaker Brent crude which was struggling to move off the bottom of a narrow range, dealers said.
June gas oil closed $1.75 lower at $172.50 a tonne, slipping further behind the July contract which finished at $173.50.
Traders said the wider prompt contango reflected softer sentiment on European spot markets, where diesel was reported to be in ample supply.
Brent crude, meanwhile, was trading 20 cents lower at $19.28 a barrel by 1707 GMT, just three cents off the day's low.
